svg.title: Amiga workflow: skills and agents
svg.desc: Follow a software change from planning to publication on local master. After the task commit, the diagram forks into unchanged fast-forward, merge and explicitly authorized rebase paths. The paths meet at conditional publication. Additional skills are grouped by purpose and primary executor.
svg.text: You choose an operation. The main session runs it or assigns the indicated specialist and brings back the result.
A software change from plan to local master
Follow the arrows for a typical change in an existing task worktree. Preparation collects the evidence needed before commit.
A check fails or a reviewer requests a change
Select a repair, prepare the revised candidate and repeat affected checks and reviews.

g.aria-label: Integration in the task worktree and publication on local master
g.text: Approve the integration plan before changing either branch
Record local master (B), the task tip and the method. An authorized unverified working commit takes the full integration path below.
Unchanged, tested fast-forward
The approved plan accepts this clean tip.
It contains B and committed closure.
Confirm that this exact tip was tested.
Merge master into the task branch
Default when histories have diverged.
Resolve merge conflicts if they occur.
Rebase task commits onto B
Only by explicit choice. Record the original
task tip (S), then replay the agreed commits
and resolve any conflicts in the task worktree.
Reconcile and prepare the combined candidate
Reconcile code, tests and tracked documents. Prepare fixes and closure.
Already contains B but lacks tested-tip evidence or committed closure? Start the full checks here.
Assess specification compliance and vault links. Reuse evidence where its scope still matches.
Verify the integrated result and obtain all four review approvals
Run the commit profile against B. For a rebase, also supply S as the integration source.
Select repairs for findings, then prepare again and repeat the affected checks and reviews.
Seal the approved tested tip
The accept-tested operation records the
existing commit as the publishable tip (C).
Freeze the verified result, finish any prepared commits and seal C
Finish a pending merge commit or add an agreed fix or closure commit when needed.
TA-commit-batch binds the final task tip (C) to the accepted tree and integration evidence.
Publish on local master
In the primary checkout, advance master from B to C only if master still equals B. If master moved, restart integration at its new tip.
Find an additional skill by what you need to do
Each group shows the primary executor. Select a skill in the standalone map to open its instructions.

50 skills · 7 specialist roles · 1 main session. A role can be used several times during a task.
